mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_MES_MID_NIGHT_SHIFT_FINISH WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}
mapper.update: merge into T_MID_NIGHT_SHIFT_FINISH a USING ( SELECT CASE WHEN QUERY_CODE = 'CLASS1' THEN FINISH_DATE + 1 ELSE FINISH_DATE END FINISH_DATE, CX_MACHINE_CODE, SAP_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE, BOM_DATA_VERSION, REMARK, CASE WHEN QUERY_CODE = 'CLASS1' THEN FINISH_QTY ELSE NULL END CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, CASE WHEN QUERY_CODE = 'CLASS2' THEN FINISH_QTY ELSE NULL END CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, nvl(UPDATE_DATE, CREATE_DATE) CREATE_TIME FROM T_MES_MID_NIGHT_SHIFT_FINISH WHERE data_version = #{dataVersion} ) b ON ( a.FINISH_DATE = b.FINISH_DATE AND b.CX_MACHINE_CODE = a.CX_MACHINE_CODE AND b.EMBRYO_CODE = a.EMBRYO_CODE AND b.BOM_DATA_VERSION = a.BOM_DATA_VERSION AND a.DEL_FLAG = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY = CASE WHEN b.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY IS NULL THEN nvl(a.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, 0) ELSE b.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY END, a.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY = CASE WHEN b.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY IS NULL THEN nvl(a.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, 0) ELSE b.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY END, a.REMARK = b.REMARK, a.UPDATE_TIME = b.CREATE_TIME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (a.id, a.FINISH_DATE, a.CX_MACHINE_CODE, a.SAP_CODE,a.embryo_code, a.bom_data_version, a.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, a.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, a.REMARK, a.create_time, a.del_flag) VALUES (get_sequence_nextval('SEQ_MID_NIGHT_SHIFT_FINISH'), b.FINISH_DATE, b.CX_MACHINE_CODE, b.SAP_CODE, b.embryo_code, b.bom_data_version, nvl(b.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, 0), nvl(b.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, 0), b.REMARK, b.create_time, '0')
